title: Mixing: I’m Losing You by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineer: Lee DeCarlo

A mixing session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 3 October 1980.

This session saw the completion of Lennon’s song ‘I’m Losing You’. The song had been recorded on 12, 18, 26, and 27 August, and 5 and 9 September 1980.
